T: Fairy tale. Real city. Real dinner.
D: A fairy-tale princess is sent to modern New York and has to find her way.
P: Serve the mains when Giselle cooks breakfast in Robert's apartment.
S: Central Park pretzels with cheddar dip
the big song in Central Park

Chewy soft pretzels dipped in a bicarb bath, salted and baked deep brown, with a warm sharp cheddar and mustard dip. Divide 500g pizza dough into 8, roll into long ropes and twist into pretzels. Boil 2L water with 4 tbsp bicarb soda and dip each for 30 seconds. Brush with egg, sprinkle with sea salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. For the dip, melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, whisk in 250ml milk until thick, then stir in 150g grated cheddar and 1 tsp mustard until smooth.
Hazelnuts and almonds roasted with honey and cinnamon
Hazelnuts and almonds tossed with honey and cinnamon, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes, cooled on baking paper and broken into clusters.
M: Buttermilk pancakes with crisp bacon and soft scrambled eggs
Pancakes, scrambled eggs, crisp bacon and fruit on one big plate, maple syrup on the side.
King and Queen's ball eye fillet
the King and Queen's costume ball where Giselle turns up in blue

Beef eye fillet roasted pink with a creamy mushroom and thyme sauce, potato gratin and grilled asparagus, dinner fit for a fairytale ball. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes with 300ml cream, garlic and salt and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Sear a seasoned 1kg eye fillet and roast at 200C for 20 minutes, then rest 10 minutes. In the same pan, fry 250g sliced mushrooms in 30g butter, add thyme, 200ml beef stock and 150ml cream, and simmer until thick. Grill 2 bunches asparagus. Slice the beef and spoon over the sauce.
W: Red apples dipped in hard red toffee on sticks
Red apples dipped in a hard red toffee of sugar and water cooked to 150C, set on baking paper.
Pink meringue kisses and strawberries dipped in white chocolate
Strawberries dipped in white chocolate and dusted with edible glitter, served next to pink meringue kisses baked at 100C for an hour.
K: Raspberry lemonade with soda water and a scoop of lemon sorbet

Homemade raspberry pink lemonade poured over a scoop of lemon sorbet so it fizzes up, with fresh raspberries and a mint leaf. Blend 125g raspberries with 100g caster sugar and the juice of 4 lemons, then strain through a sieve. Stir into 800ml chilled soda water in a jug. Put a scoop of lemon sorbet into each of 4 tall glasses and slowly pour over the pink lemonade so it foams up. Drop in a few whole raspberries and a mint leaf, and serve with a spoon and a straw.

dishes.make_ahead: Meringues up to 2 days airtight, dip berries just before serving

steps.text: Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, adding the sugar a spoon at a time and a drop of pink colouring.
Pipe small kisses onto lined trays.
Bake at 100C until crisp, then cool on the tray.
Cool the meringues completely.
Melt the white chocolate gently.
Dip the strawberries halfway in the chocolate and set on baking paper.
Dust with edible glitter and serve both together.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 week in an airtight jar

steps.text: Toss the hazelnuts and almonds with the honey and cinnamon.
Spread on a lined tray.
Roast at 170C, stirring once.
Cool on baking paper, then break into clusters.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the batter up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; cook the pancakes, bacon and eggs just before serving

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, 2 of the eggs and the buttermilk into a batter.
Cook the pancakes in half the butter in the pan and keep warm.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Scramble the remaining eggs softly in the rest of the butter.
Slice the strawberries.
Pile everything onto big plates with the maple syrup on the side.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, 2 of the eggs and the buttermilk into a batter.
Cook the pancakes in a buttered pan and keep warm.
Fry the mushrooms in the rest of the butter with the smoked paprika and soy sauce until crisp at the edges.

dishes.make_ahead: Best the same day; dip the apples up to 4 hours ahead and leave them uncovered on baking paper in a cool, dry spot

Boil the sugar, water and red colouring to 150C without stirring.
Dip each apple and twist to coat.
Set on baking paper and leave to harden.

dishes.make_ahead: Blend and strain the raspberry and lemon mix up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; stir into the soda water, scoop the sorbet and pour just before serving

Put a scoop of sorbet into each tall glass.

Pancakes, bacon and scrambled eggs.veg: Buttermilk pancakes with smoky mushrooms and soft scrambled eggs

s.note: Hazelnuts and almonds roasted with honey and cinnamon
s.how: Toss 150g hazelnuts and 150g almonds with 3 tbsp honey and a pinch of cinnamon. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 12 minutes. Cool on baking paper and break into clusters. A chipmunk would talk all day about them.

m.note: Buttermilk pancakes with crisp bacon and soft scrambled eggs
m.how: Whisk 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs and 375ml buttermilk and cook pancakes. Fry 8 rashers of bacon and scramble 4 eggs softly. Pile it all onto big plates with sliced strawberries and maple syrup on the side.

w.note: Red apples dipped in hard red toffee on sticks
w.how: Push sticks into 6 red apples. Boil 400g sugar with 150ml water and red colouring to 150C without stirring. Dip each apple and twist to coat, then set on baking paper. Leave to harden. Maybe do not take a bite from a stranger.

w.note: Pink meringue kisses and strawberries dipped in white chocolate
w.how: Whisk 2 egg whites with 120g sugar and a drop of pink colouring to stiff peaks, pipe small kisses and bake at 100C for an hour. Dip 250g strawberries in melted white chocolate and dust with edible glitter. Serve both together.

d.note: Raspberry lemonade with soda water and a scoop of lemon sorbet
d.how: Blend 125g raspberries with 100g caster sugar and the juice of 4 lemons, then strain through a sieve. Stir into 800ml chilled soda water in a jug. Put a scoop of lemon sorbet into each of 4 tall glasses and slowly pour over the pink lemonade so it foams up. Drop in a few whole raspberries and a mint leaf, and serve with a spoon and a straw.
